summary: MSVC-generated SEH-guarded one-time global object initializer (canonical sub_57ADB0). Registers a per-frame SEH handler seeded with the read-only global unk_8D3BF9, applies a shared first-entry guard on dword_5E9EF4 (construction runs only on the first call; later calls increment the counter and skip the body), and on the first call builds a fixed chain of global objects (unk_8D4370, unk_8D4248, dword_8D4330, unk_8D42A0, unk_8D42D8, dword_8D43C8, dword_8D4210, dword_8D423C) through SEH/vtable/locale constructor helpers, cross-wiring entries with the address of unk_8D42A0 and OR-ing flag value 2 into one slot. Returns the original ecx value saved at frame slot a1-20.

local_names.v1: incoming ecx value saved at a1-20 and returned unchanged
local_names.v2: first-call flag selected by the dword_5E9EF4 guard
local_names.v3: cached pointer dword_8D4330 used for the first wiring store
local_names.v4: cached pointer dword_8D43C8 used for the second wiring store

operations.description: Register the per-frame SEH handler via SEHHandlerInit, seeding it with the read-only global unk_8D3BF9.
Save the incoming ecx value v1 at frame slot a1-20 and initialize the SEH scope marker slot a1-16 to 0.
Invoke sub_59A54D(a1-16) to set up the SEH registration scope before the guarded body.
First-entry guard on the shared counter dword_5E9EF4: when it is negative it is reset to 1 and the first-call flag v2 is set; otherwise it is incremented and v2 is cleared.
Invoke sub_59A5E9(a1-16) to finalize the SEH scope after the guard.
Only when v2 (first call) run the global object construction chain; each step records its object index 0 through 6 at frame slot a1-4 for unwind tracking.
Wire dword_8D4330: store the address of unk_8D42A0 into slot dword_8D4330 + *(dword_8D4330 + 4) + 44.
Wire dword_8D43C8: store the address of unk_8D42A0 into slot dword_8D43C8 + *(dword_8D43C8 + 4) + 44 and OR flag value 2 into slot dword_8D43C8 + *(dword_8D43C8 + 4) + 12.
Wire dword_8D423C: store the address of unk_8D42A0 into slot dword_8D423C + *(dword_8D4210 + 4).
Return the saved incoming value at frame slot a1-20 (the original ecx v1).

unresolved: Identity and owning class of the constructed global objects (unk_8D4370, unk_8D4248, dword_8D4330, unk_8D42A0, unk_8D42D8, dword_8D43C8, dword_8D4210, dword_8D423C) are not evidenced by the packet.
Whether this is a CRT iostream/locale static-init block (locale helper names) or an application global initializer is unresolved.
The vtable tables off_5E6748, unk_5E6768 and unk_5E6788 passed to the constructor helpers are not separately evidenced here.
sub_59A54D and sub_59A5E9 are visible only as named calls in the raw source; their SEH frame-helper behavior is inferred from call position and no callee address is evidenced.
Purpose of the shared counter dword_5E9EF4 beyond guarding first-time construction is unknown.
